text_block_list.text:
Lately, Kawakami Princess has clearly 
'changed,' even in mock races.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I can do this, haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much... Though I went 
and got overly hyped up again...

True to her word, she came out blazing far 
faster in the opening stretch than our 
strategy called for. However...
choice_data_list:
You've definitely grown, no doubt about 
it.

text_block_list.text:
In the past, tensing up for the "race" 
like that would have stiffened her body 
and completely wrecked her form.

However, she no longer forgot how she 
ought to handle her body. She had learned 
to control her power.
choice_data_list: Your form was really coming together too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ! Ehehe... Thank you very much...♪

Having grown accustomed to the 
high-tension environment of a race, she 
learned to run without excessive strain. 
If so, then now is the time—
choice_data_list:
...I have something important to talk 
about.

...I have something important to talk 
about.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Is this... an important discussion?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is simply maaarvelous! Chef, another 
bowl, if you please!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Master
text_block_list.text:
Full of spirit, aren't ya, missy? Here ya 
go, extra noodles on the house!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Since Trainer-san is treating me today! 
I'll be sure to order at least 5 more 
servings of noodles.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Still, having an important talk at a 
ramen shop, Trainer... Heheh."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...It's just like episode 10 of 
PreFighter. Like when the legendary 
Trainer makes an important confession...
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's why I want to talk here.
Right, that's why I wanted to talk here.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: You should run in the Oaks too!
You should run in the Oaks too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-T-The Oaks?! The Oaks?!?!?! Are you 
serious?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wha-wha-whaaa?! Because the Oaks is a GⅠ, 
you know?! It's a once-in-a-lifetime 
pinnacle battle on the Tiara route—
choice_data_list:
You wanted to take on the challenge too, 
didn't you?

You wanted to take on the challenge too, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For a princess, a tiara is a dream. After 
all, it is a princess's crown... that can 
only be earned on the highest stage of a 
GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if competing on the Tiara route 
can awaken my dormant power... it'd be 
kinda like PreFigh, wouldn't it?"

...I knew all along that she wanted to run 
the Tiara route.
choice_data_list:
Let's help your power blossom like a true 
princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "...Ehe, ehehe. Thank you very much...♪"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...And that is what happened, King-san! 
Isn't my Trainer just wonderful!?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you full of surprises? Though 
shouldn't you be attending today's press 
conference?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A press conference...? ............

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I completely f-f-forgot! Even though my 
T-T-Trainer told me so many times...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wha...?! Y-You idiot! Hurry up and get 
ready!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I, King, will gladly lend you a hand for a 
little while. Come on, run!

...The press conference starts in one 
minute. I've messaged Kawakami Princess 
over and over, but she still hasn't 
replied...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Excuse meee, Traiiineer-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*~... *pant*~... Did I... make it 
in time...?
choice_data_list: Let's hurry and get into the venue!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hai-eee~! Charge, right?! Charge... 
ch-charge...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A-All-out charge, you say~~~?!?!
(CRUNCH-SMASH!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: "...The door. With just a single kick...?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"D-Did I make it in time!? I am Kawakami 
Princess, pleased to make your 
acquaintance!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ahaha! What an unconventional 
Umamusume. To think someone like her was 
out there!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Totally! I wanted to capture that 
exact moment on camera so bad! I really 
wish I could've shown my editor-in-chief~

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Then please recreate it one more 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's pull ourselves together. We'll 
begin the runner interviews. First up is—

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you all for gathering here 
today. I have walked the Tiara route 
leading all the way up to this Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I will prove the value of the hard work I 
have built up through my results. That is 
all from me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of the overwhelming 
favorite... so poised. No wonder she's 
overwhelmingly popular on the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Now then, moving on to...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. M-Me!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Y-Yes?! Well then, next person, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And finally, if anyone has questions, 
please raise your hand.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: K... Kawakami Princess-san?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You there with the yellow and pink striped 
ear ornament! Is that hair accessory 
themed after Honey Lemon Princess from 
'Sugar Love♪ Pretty Cure' !?

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa, me!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You like PreFie as well!? I love it 
too! That is all for my questions!!

choice_data_list:
...I would appreciate it if you could skip 
that last question.

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft... Ahahahaha! You and your Trainer 
make quite the unique duo! I'm sure you'll 
gain plenty of fans from here on out!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? Eek!? Th-Thank you very much!?

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, this is the press conference for 
the Oaks runners, you know? Shouldn't you 
act a little more properly?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!! My name is Kawakami Princess!? My 
goal for this year is the Oaks, and...

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, no need for more 
self-introductions~. Fufu, just relax and 
answer the questions, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's over... It's all over for me, 
waaaah...
choice_data_list: ...Let's work on staying calmer next time.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, yes…… I suppose this is practice as 
well……"

"...While she's grown used to racing, it 
seems her mental fortitude still 'shows 
room for growth.'"

However, conversely, if she learns to 
remain composed and grounded at all times, 
her stability in races will also be 
strengthened—

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kawakami Princess-san~! Do you have a 
moment right now?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What could it beee...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, honestly, I just wanted to pass on 
some words of encouragement. My kids have 
become total fans of Kawakami 
Princess-san.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
She said she's super excited to go watch 
the next Oaks with her friends too. Um... 
Good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Oh myyy goodness!! Understood, loud and 
clear!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm going to take 1st place in 
the Oaks! A princess must claim victory, 
after all~!

One moment she's downcast, the next 
bursting with energy. Seeing that Kawakami 
Princess is still very much a young girl 
at heart, we pledged together to claim 
victory in the Oaks.
